notes: equipment[] is AND: every listed item is required. Either/or cases are separate exercises.
substitutes[] is ordered nearest-equivalent first. For every required item, at least one substitute does not need it.

Selection rule: take the first substitute whose equipment is all available, skipping beginner_ok=false entries for beginners and entries whose avoid_if matches the user. Validated: beginner_ok exercises keep per-item coverage after the beginner filter.
single_implement=true: the load is the weight of ONE dumbbell held with both hands, not per hand.
cable_high / cable_low also count the pulleys on a lat pulldown station (see equipment notes).
evidence_note_vi comes from search-result summaries, not full papers (UNVERIFIED).
source_status: read = page fetched and cues checked against it; url_only = URL confirmed to exist but content not compared (treat cues as UNVERIFIED); none = no source (UNVERIFIED).
start_load_* are UNVERIFIED beginner heuristics in the unit of load_type; null = bodyweight. band_level uses light/medium/heavy.
avoid_if / safer_alternative are general heuristics, not medical advice.

load_type.barbell_kg: Tổng kg trên thanh đòn (tính cả thanh)
load_type.machine_kg: Kg trên máy/cáp (số ghi trên chồng tạ, hoặc tổng bánh tạ lắp vào máy)
load_type.added_kg: Kg tạ lắp thêm, KHÔNG tính thanh/khung (Smith, landmine)
load_type.band_level: Mức dây kháng lực (light / medium / heavy)
load_type.bodyweight_reps: Số lần với trọng lượng cơ thể
